# media / storage

The **media** type's DB column: `jsonb`, through `Fields.Storage`'s `decode`
arm — the field's own schema (`max`, unique ids) decodes it on every read and
write, as for `tags`. Media has its own contribution because storage
resolution is exact-token (no `extends` fallback).
